refactor_suggestions.text: `routes/documents.py:116,230` — check `request.headers["content-length"]` and read `UploadFile` in chunks up to `max_file_bytes + 1`, returning 413 early; move `get_by_id` (`:111`) into the threadpool call or the use case.

`schemas/conversations.py:31-39` — restrict `AddMessageRequest.role` to `user` (or drop the route if unused by the UI); add `max_length` to `ChatRequest.question`, `InferAssistantRequest.question`, `CreateAssistantRequest.*`, `SaveApiKeyRequest.api_key`.

`api/errors.py` — register global handlers for `DomainValidationError` (422), `*NotFoundError` (404), `IndexOutdatedError`/`ReindexInProgressError` (409), and an `LLMNotConfiguredError` (503); delete the ~15 per-route try/except blocks and the bare `ValueError`/`RuntimeError` catches; standardise on one envelope `{detail, code}`.

`routes/{conversations,assistants,documents,index}.py` — move assistant existence checks into the use cases after `AccessControl` (return 404 for both missing and forbidden), removing `_existing_assistant_id` and its copies.

`routes/admin.py:113-178` — extract `TestGlobalApiKeyUseCase` taking an `LLMGatewayFactory` port; reuse `build_llm_gateway` so `LLM_API_URL` is read in one place; audit after the outcome with success/failure.

`reindex_assistant.py:178-185`: add `DocumentRepository.save_many` (single transaction) and persist document metadata atomically with job success; on failure after swap, record a distinct "swapped but unsynchronized" state. Why: avoids stuck-outdated index.

New `application/errors.py`: move `ConversationNotFoundError`, `AssistantNotFoundError`, `DocumentNotFoundError`, `MessageNotFoundError`, `FeedbackNotFoundError`, `DocumentTooLargeError` under one `NotFoundError(LookupError)` base (and a `DocumentIndexingError` for provider faults, so `process_ingestion.py:158` stops catching bare `ValueError`). Why: removes cross-use-case imports and ambiguous mapping.

Split `chat_with_assistant.py` per the cohesion proposal and hide langgraph behind a small `TurnPipeline` seam (or drop it for `infer_assistant.py`, replacing the 4-node graph with 4 method calls). Why: 794-line class, framework in application layer.

Extract shared guards into `application/services/guards.py`: `load_active_document`, `ensure_no_reindex`, `utc_now`; add missing `AuditAction` members and tighten `require_*` signatures to `AuditAction` only. Why: removes 4 duplicated patterns and `AuditAction | str`.

`manage_conversation.py:123` and `infer_assistant.py`: restrict `AddMessageUseCase` roles (or delete it if the API does not need it) and inject `UsageGovernance` into `InferAssistantUseCase`; move RF-42 filtering for infer into the use case. Why: closes the forged-history and usage-limit bypass paths.

`infra/keycloak/nexus-realm.json`: split into `nexus-realm.json` (clients, roles, mappers, `full.path: true`, refresh rotation, password policy, `sslRequired: all`) and `nexus-realm.dev-users.json`; fail bootstrap when `${...}` vars are unresolved.

`backend/src/infrastructure/secrets/cipher.py:13`: accept a proper Fernet key (or scrypt-derived with salt), wrap in `MultiFernet` for rotation; validate in app startup instead of `dependencies.py:177`.

`backend/src/infrastructure/auth/keycloak_token_verifier.py:90-137`: add `typ`/`azp` checks, leeway, stale-key cap, out-of-lock single-flight refresh, min key size; convert `DomainValidationError` in `_to_user` to `AuthenticationError`.

`backend/src/application/use_cases/manage_assistant_access.py:178-200`: serialize document-restriction changes with reindex start (advisory lock keyed on assistant id) and authorize via assistant scope before revealing document existence.

`backend/src/application/services/access_control.py:123-193`: collapse admin-only `require_*` into one `_require(predicate, action, resource, resource_id)` helper and pass the target resource id so `access.denied` events always carry it.

`repositories.py:134-165` — Add `list_summaries(assistant_id, owner, limit, cursor)` that selects conversation columns only (plus optional last-message subquery); drop `selectinload(messages)` from listings; keep full load for `get_by_id`.
`models.py:43-50,200-204` — Add `passive_deletes=True` to cascade relationships; delete via `delete(Model).where(...)` so PG `ON DELETE CASCADE` does the work.

New migration `0008` — Indexes: `conversations(owner_user_id, assistant_id, updated_at DESC)`, `messages(conversation_id, created_at)`, `usage_records(assistant_id)`, `documents(replaces_document_id)`, `audit_events(user_id, occurred_at)`; convert `audit_events.details` to `jsonb` + expression index on `(details->>'assistant_id')`; CHECK constraints for status/role/rating columns. Mirror in `models.py`.
`base.py:4` — Set `MetaData(naming_convention=...)` and `env.py:26` `compare_type=True, compare_server_default=True`; align `server_default`s in `models.py` with migrations so autogenerate is clean.

`repositories.py` / `operations_repositories.py` — Extract a `_commit()` helper (commit, rollback on exception, map `IntegrityError`) and move toward a Unit of Work where the application layer commits; replace settings/feedback/secret upserts with `postgresql.insert(...).on_conflict_do_update`.

`compose.yaml` (all `env_file` blocks, lines 6-9 etc.): replace the required `.env.example` load with a `.env`-required model or use `${VAR:?}` for secrets (`POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `QDRANT_API_KEY`, `KEYCLOAK_*`, `NEXUS_SECRETS_KEY`) and scope `environment:` per service. Why: removes silent default secrets and least-privilege leakage.

`compose.yaml` ports (lines 11,69,88,142,167,186,197,213): bind to `127.0.0.1:` for postgres, qdrant, backend, keycloak, prometheus, jaeger, grafana and publish only the frontend. Why: closes direct DB/vector/metrics access and the `/metrics` bypass.

`scripts/backup.sh` + `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: quiesce writers (stop worker, or take Postgres first then Qdrant under a write pause), write `counts.txt` from the dump source, add `set -o pipefail`, and add a CI job that runs backup then restore against ephemeral Postgres/Qdrant service containers plus `shellcheck` over all scripts. Why: proves consistency and restore.

`infra/docker/*.Dockerfile`: add non-root `USER` (or `nginx-unprivileged`), pin base images by digest, switch frontend to `npm ci`, and add `pip-compile`/`uv` lock with hashes plus torch in the lock; align the Qdrant client and server versions. Why: security and reproducibility.

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `scripts/quality-gate.sh`: add a `docker compose build` job, `pip-audit`/`npm audit`, Trivy, Dependabot; add `--build` to `compose run` in quality-gate/eval. Why: catches broken images and stale-image gate results.

`nexus.effects.ts:259` and `nexus-api.service.ts:215-237`: make the stream pipeline emit a failure when it completes without a terminal event, add `cancelChatStream` with `takeUntil`, normalise CRLF and flush the tail on Response. Why: removes the stuck-spinner and lost-last-event bugs.

`markdown.pipe.ts`: custom marked renderer that strips/rewrites `image` and adds `rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"` to links; fix `decodeHtml` order; throttle input (or memoise by text) during streaming. Why: closes exfiltration channel and cuts re-render cost.

`auth.service.ts:112-125` + `oidc-client.ts:155`: give `OidcError` an HTTP `status`/`code`, expire only on `invalid_grant`, retry network failures with backoff; strip `code`/`state` from the URL when `completeLogin` throws. Why: avoids spurious logouts and the stuck error loop.

`nexus.reducer.ts` / `nexus.selectors.ts`: drop flat `documents`, adopt `@ngrx/entity` for assistants/conversations/documents, derive `currentConversationId` from `selectedConversationByAssistant`, use shared `EMPTY` constants and narrow input selectors. Why: removes state duplication and spurious emissions.

`nexus.effects.ts:525-603`: re-arm polling on failure of background loads (or use `expand`/`repeat`), cap `uploadDocument` concurrency, move `saveBlob` side effect into a `tap` guarded by try/catch. Why: polling and uploads survive transient errors.

`process_ingestion.py` + `IngestionJobQueue`: add `renew(job, until)` called from `DocumentIndexer` progress hooks (per page/batch) and make `complete/retry/fail` conditional on `(id, attempts, status='reserved')`; abort work if the update affects 0 rows.

`reindex_assistant.py:244`: renew lease inside `_reindex_document` (per OCR page / embed batch) and make `ReindexJobRepository.save` fence on `attempts`; skip `_discard`/`_swap_alias` if ownership is lost.

`text_extraction.py:136-190` + `ocr.py`: one shared `_run_tool(cmd, timeout)` helper with timeout, isolated LibreOffice profile, and map `TimeoutExpired` to a dedicated retryable error; run pypdf/docx parsing under a page cap and subprocess with `RLIMIT_AS`.

`process_ingestion.py:152`: replace type-based classification with explicit `UnreadableDocumentError` / `TransientServiceError` raised by extractors and gateways; wrap pypdf/docx/zip errors as unreadable.

Delete `extract_supported_text`, `_extract_pdf_text`, `_extract_docx_text` (`text_extraction.py:24-113`) and keep only `structured_extraction.py`; move `_extract_doc_text` there. Make `LocalDocumentFileStorage.save` (`local_file_storage.py:35`) atomic and non-overwriting (temp file + `os.replace`, fail if exists).

`chat_with_assistant.py:139-189` — move `_ranked_so_far`/`_usage_so_far` into a per-turn context object passed through `_stream_events`/`execute`; build graphs once at module/class level. Removes race and compile cost.

`chat_with_assistant.py:493-494` — persist user + assistant messages together in `persist_assistant_message` (or mark the user message `failed` in `_finish_failure`) so failed turns are excluded from history.

`qdrant_store.py:36,142-157` — pass explicit `timeout=` to `QdrantClient`, add bounded retry with backoff for `ResponseHandlingException`/5xx, and only fall back to legacy search when the error is a missing-vector-name 400. Also assert `embedding_model` of the collection matches the configured model.

`infer_assistant.py:87-106` — use `generate_with_usage` + record usage; system-instruction the routing rules, delimit the question, strip code fences, catch `AttributeError`, log parse failures; prefer JSON mode/response_format in the gateway.

`grounded_answer.py:118-123` + `prompt_injection.py` — send `REWRITE_INSTRUCTION` as `system_instruction` with the question delimited; run `detect_prompt_injection` on the question too; strip zero-width/format chars (`unicodedata.category == "Cf"`) in `_normalize`; share one `fold_text` helper with `bm25_sparse_embedding.py:31`.

concerns.text: **high** — Unbounded upload buffering: `await file.read()` before size enforcement (`documents.py:116`, `:230`) enables memory exhaustion.
**high** — `POST /conversations/{id}/messages` lets clients write `assistant`/`system` turns (`schemas/conversations.py:31-34`), poisoning history fed to the LLM.
**med** — Assistant existence 404 checked before authorization in 6 routes, giving an ID-enumeration oracle and contradicting RN-24.
**med** — Error mapping leaks/misclassifies: `ValueError->422` for missing LLM config, `RuntimeError->502` with raw `str(exc)`; four different error envelope shapes.
**med** — No length caps on chat/infer questions and assistant prompts; several list endpoints unpaged; `/metrics` unauthenticated in-app.
(high) Reindex post-swap document persistence is non-atomic and can leave the index permanently "outdated" with uploads blocked: `reindex_assistant.py:178-185`.
(med) `AddMessageUseCase` lets users forge `assistant` role messages, with no access/usage/audit control: `manage_conversation.py:123-146`.
(med) `DeleteAssistantUseCase` orders DB-then-Qdrant without recovery, skips audit on failure and leaks original files: `manage_assistant_access.py:51-67`.
(med) Worker treats any `ValueError` (including provider vector-count mismatch) as permanent "unreadable document": `process_ingestion.py:158` + `document_indexing.py:87`.
(med) Inconsistent exception taxonomy (NotFound as ValueError vs LookupError), langgraph in application layer, and `infer_assistant` bypassing usage governance.
Realm file mixes dev seed users with the only realm definition — default admin password ships wherever it is imported.
Two sources of truth for document restrictions (Postgres + Qdrant payload) with a non-atomic check-then-write against reindex.
Group matching by leaf name breaks isolation as soon as nested groups exist.
Audit trail covers app actions well but has no authentication-failure or IdP-side (role/group change) visibility.
Verifier/directory caching correctness depends on composition-layer singletons not visible in this segment.
**high** — Conversation listings eager-load every message with no pagination (`repositories.py:134-165`); will degrade linearly with chat history.
**high** — Missing rollback on failed commits across ~14 write paths; long-lived worker sessions get poisoned (`repositories.py`, `operations_repositories.py`).
**med** — Repositories own commits: no Unit of Work, so audit + action + group changes are not atomic; audit trail can diverge from reality.
**med** — Index gaps on hot paths: conversation listing composite, audit `details->>'assistant_id'` on `json`, `usage_records.assistant_id` FK.
**med** — No CHECK constraints for enum-like status columns; ORM cascades without `passive_deletes` cause N+1 deletes.

**High** Default credentials (`nexus`, `admin`, `nexus-local`, `nexus-backend-dev-secret`, `change-me-in-local-env`) ship as the required base env file and nothing fails fast when unchanged, combined with every service published on all host interfaces, including Postgres, Qdrant, Keycloak `start-dev
**High** Backup is not cross-store consistent (Postgres, Qdrant and files dumped at different moments with writers running) and the restore path is untested in CI (syntax check only).
**Med** Images run as root, are unpinned by digest, and are about two years old; builds are not reproducible (no lockfile or hashes for Python, `npm install` in the image vs `npm ci` in CI).
**Med** CI does not build the images, run integration tests, lint beyond F/E9, audit dependencies, or scan secrets; `qdrant-client 1.19.1` vs server `v1.11.3` mismatch goes unchecked.
**Med** `quality-gate.sh` and `eval.sh` run against the last built image rather than the working tree, so a green gate can describe stale code.
(high) SSE stream that ends without `done`/`error` leaves `chatStream` and `loading.sendChat` set forever; no cancel action either (`nexus.effects.ts:237-267`, `nexus-api.service.ts:215`).
(med) Remote images from LLM markdown survive sanitising, enabling zero-click data exfiltration via prompt injection (`markdown.pipe.ts:39`).
(med) Any refresh failure, including network errors, logs the user out (`auth.service.ts:112-125`).
(med) Document/index polling stops permanently after one failed poll (`nexus.effects.ts:525-603`).

(med) Selectors return fresh `[]`/objects and depend on the whole feature state; combined with per-token actions and full markdown re-parse each delta, streaming is O(n²) in re-render work (`nexus.selectors.ts:102-128,159-164`; `nexus.reducer.ts:460`).

No lease renewal / fencing for ingestion jobs and per-document-only renewal for reindex: multi-worker deployments double-process and can delete each other's Qdrant data (`process_ingestion.py:399`, `reindex_assistant.py:208`, `:229-235`).
Timeout-less subprocesses for `.doc` (`text_extraction.py:139/153/168`) and unbounded in-process parsers: one bad file hangs workers serially (poison pill).
Exception-type retry classification misroutes corrupt-file and provider errors (`process_ingestion.py:152-160`).
Non-atomic activation/complete and swap/PG-update sequences leave PG and Qdrant inconsistent after partial failure (`process_ingestion.py:263-275`, `reindex_assistant.py:178-185`).
No DLQ-style visibility: no metrics or alerts for failed/abandoned jobs or queue depth.
**[high] Orphan user messages**: persistence before LLM/Qdrant calls with no compensation (`chat_with_assistant.py:494,549`).
**[high if singleton] Per-request state on use-case instance** (`chat_with_assistant.py:139-140`): concurrent turns cross-contaminate audit `retrieved_documents` and usage/billing.
**[med] Fail-open ACL + `None` bypass** (`qdrant_store.py:358,383`): correctness depends entirely on ingestion always writing `allowed_groups`.
**[med] Unvalidated streamed text + syntactic-only citation check** (`chat_with_assistant.py:266`, `citations.py:96`).
**[med] Router JSON parsing and missing usage accounting** (`infer_assistant.py:88,100,104`).

Same for `build_group_directory()` (`dependencies.py:204`) — token + group cache would be lost each call. Composition segment must confirm.

Belong in application/domain.
- **Transaction ownership**: repositories commit internally, so use cases cannot make multi-repo writes atomic (e.g. assistant save + `set_assistant_groups` + `audit.append`). Route to application segment: introduce Unit of Work.
- **Audit atomicity**: `PostgresAuditLogRepository.append` commits independently (`repositories.py:537`) — audited action and audit row can diverge. Route to auth/audit segment.
- **Metrics in DB layer**: `ingestion_job_gauges` (`operations_repositories.py:379`) imports `infrastructure.observability.metrics`; belongs in observability.
- **Session lifecycle in worker**: queue/reindex repositories call `rollback()` after reads (`repositories.py:312,328,440`) implyi

- Verify the backend refuses default secrets (`NEXUS_SECRETS_KEY=change-me-in-local-env`, `nexus` DB password, `nexus-local` Qdrant key) when `APP_ENV` is not `local`; nothing in this segment enforces it (api-http / auth reviewers).
- `/metrics` exposure: `compose.yaml:11-12` publishes the backend port on all host interfaces, so the Nginx-only protection noted by another reviewer is bypassable at `host:8000/metrics` (api-http / auth).
- `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (`.env.example:77`) must be kept manually in sync with `NEXUS_FRONTEND_URL` (`.env.example:68`): candidate for deriving one from the other in the config module.

- Table list in `backup-common.sh:15` is hardcoded; the database/migrations reviewer should confirm it covers all tables (e.g. ingestion job tables are not counted).
- `LLM_API_KEY` is absent from `.env

- Verify `app.routes.ts` applies `roleGuard()` to every route (guard coverage cannot be judged from this segment). `roleGuard` returns `false` on status "error" (`access.ts:23`), so the app shell must render `selectSessionError`, otherwise the user sees a blank page.
- Components in other segments call `nexusActions.stopDocumentPolling`; if a component forgets to dispatch it on destroy, polling continues while the same assistant stays active.
- `/config.json` (`auth.service.ts:12`) and nginx/CSP: no CSP is visible here; the markdown image-exfiltration finding below depends on `img-src`/`connect-src` policy set in the web server segment.

- Backend 429/error body contracts (`usage_limit`, `duplicate_document`) are duplicated as TS interfaces here (`chat-stream.ts:82`, `document-lifecycle.ts:82`).

Verify there.
- **data segment**: confirm a DB unique constraint on `(assistant_id, content_hash)`; `find_by_hash` (`ingest_document.py:112`) is check-then-act under concurrent uploads.
- **domain segment**: confirm `ReindexInProgressError` / `IndexOutdatedError` are not subclasses of `DomainValidationError`/`ValueError`; if `ReindexInProgressError` is, the D8 race path (`process_ingestion.py:294`) fails documents definitively instead of retrying.
- **api segment**: size limit is checked after the whole upload is in memory (`ingest_document.py:89` receives `bytes`); enforce streaming limit / `Content-Length` at the route. Also confirm `IngestDocumentInput.document_id` / `new_

- **LLM gateway (openai segment)**: `max_tokens`, `temperature`, timeout, retry/backoff and chunk delimiting (`<trecho>` tags implied by `prompt_injection.py:39`) all live in the adapter, not here. Verify: (a) `max_tokens` set; (b) chunk text escapes `</trecho>`; (c) exceptions are mapped to `ValueError/RuntimeError`, otherwise the rewrite fallback at `grounded_answer.py:124` does not catch timeouts.
- **API/DI segment**: lifetime of `ChatWithAssistantUseCase`. It holds per-request mutable state (`_ranked_so_far`, `_usage_so_far`, `chat_with_assistant.py:139-140`). Singleton = cross-user audit/usage contamination; per-request = 3 LangGraph compiles per request (`:141-143`).
- **API segment**: sync model inference + Qdrant calls must run in threadpool (`def` routes), not inside `async def` routes, or the event loop blocks.
- **API segment**: no question length cap here; `ChatWithAssistantInput.question` is unbounded (cost + rewrite prompt size).
- **Ingestion segment**: ACL is fail-open
